walkthroughs.title: Foundation Excavation Ep.26
walkthroughs.what_it_shows: Field crawl bulk dig on the Roseburg spec house. Paint lines, 8 in past footprint then 2–3 ft for masons, laser depth, export, compact, 3/4-minus gravel. Clip never says 2-story — that is listing + EP.23. Not a full basement hole. Do not file as m-P04-full-excavation.

labor.named_not_headcount: ORNL checklist names grading contractor, construction contractor, landscape contractor; AF&PA names job foreman, subcontractors, building inspector — not a headcount

labor_notes: Do not invent crew counts. ORNL names grading / construction / landscape contractors. AF&PA names job foreman, subcontractors, building inspector.
remodel_note: Remodel extras (matching, occupied-site, shoring) not in these books — Gap, do not invent remodel-only methods.
habit_scope: ORNL excavation limits + stabilize + after-excavation-before-footing-pour hold + do not fill overexcavated trench + AF&PA compact filled ground / root-removal zones before footings. 1–2 story wood SFR / ADU. Depth follows the P05 type already on the drawings. Not 3-story, not MF, not steel.
how_it_is_done: Limits of excavation and what to protect (trees, roots, buried cables, pipes, sewers) were established in P01. Dig inside those limits. Establish precautions for stabilizing excavation (ORNL SITEWORK).
Strip and stockpile already happened in P01; spoil site is defined. Keep organics out of the hole.
HOLD: after excavation and before concrete is poured for the footings (ORNL SITE INSPECTIONS). This is the first field inspection on the ORNL ladder (P02).

Do not fill the overexcavated footing trench (ORNL FOOTINGS). Do not bear footings partially on rock — sand fill (ORNL FOOTINGS). Do not pour footings on frozen ground (ORNL FOOTINGS). Provide frost heave protection for winter construction (ORNL SITEWORK).
AF&PA Foundations: where roots of trees are removed during excavation or when building on filled ground, the ground should be well compacted before footings are installed or concrete is poured.

Compact fill under slab (ORNL FLOOR SLAB checklist). Determine proper compaction (ORNL BACKFILLING AND COMPACTION). Establish condition of fill material: if site material stays in a clump after soaking and squeezing in hand, do not use as backfill (ORNL BACKFILLING AND COMPACTION).

Wall backfill is after waterproofing (P05): establish minimum concrete strength or curing prior to backfilling; high-early if necessary; install temporary wall support during backfilling; cap backfill with an impermeable cover (ORNL BACKFILLING AND COMPACTION). Hand backfill first 8 inches on unperforated leaders to avoid damaging pipe (ORNL SUBDRAINAGE). Floor framing must exist before significant basement backfill (HUD §4.5) — that hold lives on P05/P07, not as a fake lag_days here.
Foundation-drain tile (4-in perf, holes down) is P05 CIP/CMU, not this phase. Do not shop tile as a P04 habit.
trades: construction contractor — named, not a headcount
tools_equipment: Not a tool list. Named: excavation (limits/stabilize); hand-backfill of first 8 inches over drain leaders (ORNL SUBDRAINAGE). HUD §4.4 names equipment bucket widths 12/16/24 in for footings — that is a P05 footing width note, not a P04 SKU.
inspection_hold_points: After excavation and before concrete is poured for the footings (ORNL SITE INSPECTIONS).
Do not fill the overexcavated footing trench (ORNL FOOTINGS).
Filled ground / root-removal zones compacted before footings or concrete (AF&PA Foundations).
Fill material: if it stays in a clump after soak-and-squeeze, do not use as backfill (ORNL BACKFILLING AND COMPACTION).
Compact fill under slab before the P06/P05 pour (ORNL FLOOR SLAB).
inspector_looks_for: Hole open, limits respected, utilities/trees protected (ORNL SITEWORK + first site inspection).
Bottom of excavation not frozen (ORNL FOOTINGS).
Overexcavated trench not filled back with loose dirt (ORNL FOOTINGS).
Subgrade under a future slab compacted (ORNL FLOOR SLAB).
common_messups: Filling an overexcavated footing trench (ORNL: do not).
Pouring on frozen ground (ORNL: do not).
Bearing a footing half on rock (ORNL: sand fill).
Using clumpy site dirt as backfill (ORNL soak-and-squeeze test).
Skipping compaction on filled ground or where roots were pulled (AF&PA).
Dumping wall backfill before waterproof and before the wall is cured/braced (ORNL BACKFILLING; HUD §4.5 floor-in-before-significant-backfill).
smart_save: Gap — book did not name a dollar save. High-early concrete is named only to get to backfill strength faster (ORNL BACKFILLING), not as a cheap skip.
do_not_cheap: Compact filled ground / root-removal zones before footings (AF&PA).
Do not fill the overexcavated trench (ORNL).
Do not pour on frozen ground (ORNL).
Proper compaction of fill under the slab (ORNL).
Temp wall support during backfill; min strength/cure before backfill (ORNL) — that hold is shared with P05.
material_classes: sand fill (when footing would bear partially on rock)
when_this_beats_habit: This is the habit. Depth follows the P05 type on the drawings (basement hole vs slab scrape).
when_this_is_a_bad_idea: A basement hole on a water-table veto lot (P00). Filling overexcavation. Pouring frozen. Skipping compaction on fill. Shopping drain tile as this phase.
why_tier1_never_learned_it: They did — dig, compact, call the inspector before you pour. What they skip is the overexcavated-trench rule and the soak-and-squeeze backfill test.
permit_gate: should be on drawings before permit
permit_gate_notes: Limits of excavation, frost depth of footings, and foundation type on drawings. Permit itself is P02. Confirm with AHJ / engineer.
risk_if_swapped_late: Changing basement vs slab after the hole is a type change (excavation depth, waterproofing, tile, floor package). Catch before permit.
plain_language_summary: This is the hole. Dig inside the limits you already marked. Do not bury cables. Call the inspector before any footing concrete. Do not dump dirt back into a trench you dug too deep. Do not pour on frozen ground. If you pulled trees or you are on fill, compact it before footings. Squeeze a wet handful — if it stays a clump, that dirt is not backfill. Drain tile is the foundation phase, not this one.
spanish_summary: Este es el hoyo. Cave dentro de los límites. No entierres cables. Llame al inspector antes de concreto de zapata. No rellene una zanja excavada de más. No colar en suelo congelado. Si sacó árboles o está sobre relleno, compacte antes de zapatas. Si un puño mojado queda terrón, esa tierra no es relleno. El tubo de drenaje es la fase de cimiento, no esta.

ORNL BFH SITE INSPECTIONS: After excavation and before concrete is poured for the footings

ORNL BFH BACKFILLING AND COMPACTION; FLOOR SLAB Compact fill under slab
AF&PA Details Foundations: excavation / filled ground well compacted before footings or concrete
confidence_notes: Checklist items printed. Compaction is 'determine proper compaction' — no percent Proctor invented. Bucket widths are HUD P05 footing notes, not a P04 SKU.
tools: hand-backfill first 8 in over drain leaders (ORNL SUBDRAINAGE)
layering: Do not fill the overexcavated footing trench (ORNL FOOTINGS).
Filled ground / root-removal zones compacted before footings (AF&PA).
If soak-and-squeeze stays a clump, do not use as backfill (ORNL).
Cap backfill with an impermeable cover (ORNL BACKFILLING) — after P05 waterproof.
Hand backfill first 8 inches on leaders (ORNL SUBDRAINAGE).
code_to_check: Adopted frost-depth for bottom of footing (ORNL: at least 6 inches below frost depth around perimeter). Confirm with AHJ / engineer. Do not invent a local number.
AHJ excavation / compaction tests if required — book says 'determine proper compaction', not a percent. Confirm with AHJ / engineer.
time_money: High-early concrete named only to reach backfill strength (ORNL). No dollars. No crew.
